description: Large footed vessel made as an ornament, indoors or in the garden (a cremation urn is in Religious & Ceremonial Objects).
Bowl made to be looked at or to hold small decorative items (a bowl made to hold food is in Kitchen & Dining).
Self-adhesive vinyl or film motif, pattern or lettering applied to a wall, window or furniture to decorate it.
Replica sword, gun or other weapon made for display that cannot injure, decorative wushu implements included.
Bomb, grenade, mine or artillery piece made inert and kept for display.
Plain mirror on a stand made to sit on a table or dresser (a grooming mirror is in Personal Care & Beauty).
Open holder made to hold a lit candle.
Powered device made to release fragrance into a room.
Burner or electric warmer made to melt wax melts or oil.
Essential or fragrance oil sold for a diffuser or burner (an oil sold to treat a condition is in Health, Medical & Mobility).
Holder or burner made to burn incense for scenting the home (a burner for religious rites is in Religious & Ceremonial Objects).
Bound bundle of dried herbs burned to scent or cleanse a room, not made for a named rite.
Manufactured tree made to be decorated for Christmas (a real tree is in Plants & Living Cultures).
Set of dolls made to be displayed on tiers for a festival, not made for worship.
Seasonal arrangement made to stand at an entrance for a festival.
Ornamental fountain or flowing-water feature for a garden (its pump is in Garden & Grounds).
Windsock or streamer made as a garden, festive or decorative ornament (a windsock made to show wind direction or strength is in Optical & Scientific Instruments).
Neon or LED sign made to show a lit word or motif, a decorative light that spells a message included.
Lantern made to stand or hang as decoration, lit or unlit, stone garden lanterns included.
Ring of foliage, flowers or other decoration made to hang on a door or wall as a seasonal or festive ornament (an Advent wreath made for worship is in Religious & Ceremonial Objects).
Straight-sided glass jar with a lid, often footed, made to stand on display (a jar made to store food is in Kitchen & Dining).
Small bag or pouch of scented material made to scent a drawer, wardrobe or room (an odour absorber is in Cleaning & Laundry).

Reusable display calendar of fabric, wood or card with numbered doors or pockets for the days before Christmas (one sold filled with confectionery is food; an Advent wreath is in Religious & Ceremonial Objects).
Decorative or seasonal flag made to fly from a pole bracket on a house (a country or state flag is listed under its own name).
Scented wood chips, resin or powder burned on charcoal or a heater to scent a room (incense for religious rites is in Religious & Ceremonial Objects).
